import bpy,json,hashlib,numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['setback16'];craft=ns['craft'];cap=ns['cap'];before=json.loads((cap/'source_before.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'));rigid=ns['rigid_shifts'];edited=ns['edited_objects'];retired=set(ns['retired_objects'])
def adjusted_hash(o,offset):
 h=hashlib.sha256();mat=o.matrix_world.copy();mat.translation.z-=offset;h.update(np.array(mat,dtype=np.float64).tobytes())
 if o.type=='MESH':
  for attr,size,prop in [(o.data.vertices,3,'co'),(o.data.loops,1,'vertex_index')]:
   a=np.empty(len(attr)*size,np.float64 if prop=='co' else np.int32);attr.foreach_get(prop,a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  for uv in o.data.uv_layers:
   a=np.empty(len(uv.data)*2,np.float32);uv.data.foreach_get('uv',a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  h.update(json.dumps([m.name if m else '' for m in o.data.materials]).encode())
 return h.hexdigest()
# Matrix floats can round when adding/subtracting the lowering offset. Compare original matrix
# within tolerance, and hash the original matrix together with the current geometry instead.
def shape_with_old_matrix(o):
 h=hashlib.sha256();h.update(np.array(ns['old_matrices'][o.name],dtype=np.float64).tobytes())
 if o.type=='MESH':
  for attr,size,prop in [(o.data.vertices,3,'co'),(o.data.loops,1,'vertex_index')]:
   a=np.empty(len(attr)*size,np.float64 if prop=='co' else np.int32);attr.foreach_get(prop,a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  for uv in o.data.uv_layers:
   a=np.empty(len(uv.data)*2,np.float32);uv.data.foreach_get('uv',a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  h.update(json.dumps([m.name if m else '' for m in o.data.materials]).encode())
 return h.hexdigest()
bad=[];preserved=0
for row in before:
 n=row['name']
 if n in edited or n in retired:continue
 o=craft.objects.get(n)
 if o is None or shape_with_old_matrix(o)!=row['hash']:bad.append(n);continue
 expected=ns['old_matrices'][n].copy();expected.translation.z+=rigid[n]
 if np.max(np.abs(np.array(o.matrix_world)-np.array(expected)))>1e-5:bad.append(n)
 preserved+=1
assert not bad,bad
other=json.loads((cap/'other_source_before.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'));count=0
for cname,rows in other.items():
 c=bpy.data.collections[cname]
 for n,h in rows.items():assert c.objects.get(n) and ns['digest'](c.objects[n])==h,(cname,n);count+=1
checks=['Unreshaped components preserve geometry, UV, materials and expected rigid translations','Other original assets remain unchanged','Source saved']
assert not bpy.data.is_dirty
assert len(craft.objects)==3074
checks.append('Six obsolete tall stair/base objects archived outside export')
for y in np.linspace(-5.3,2.85,164):
 assert ns['floorheight'](float(y))>=max(ns['baseheight'](x,float(y)) for x in np.linspace(-1.525,1.525,9))+.048
checks.append('Regraded central basin stays above the existing sand')
boat=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_front_A timber repair boat')]
boatmin=min((o.matrix_world@Vector(v)).z for o in boat for v in o.bound_box)
blockmax=max((o.matrix_world@Vector(v)).z for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_front_A keel block') for v in o.bound_box)
assert abs(boatmin-blockmax)<.003,(boatmin,blockmax)
checks.append('Repair boat keel rests on its adjusted blocks')
for i in range(2):
 o=craft.objects['Combined_front_A outer steps'+('' if i==0 else '.001')];top=max((o.matrix_world@Vector(v)).z for v in o.bound_box);assert abs(top-[.88,.74][i])<.003
checks.append('Two low side treads replace five tall treads')
ground=json.loads((cap/'ground_fit.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'));assert ground['seam_max']<0 and len(ns['bank'].data.vertices)==2711
checks.append('Regraded bank maintains original footprint and meets the sand')
out={'checks':checks,'rigid_shape_preserved':preserved,'other_objects_unchanged':count,'edited_objects':sorted(edited),'retired_objects':sorted(retired),'repair_boat_keel':boatmin,'block_top':blockmax,'unexpected':bad,'source_saved':not bpy.data.is_dirty}
(cap/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8');print('SETBACK16_SOURCE_AUDIT',len(checks),'checks;',preserved,'rigid shapes;',count,'other assets unchanged')
